chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Join Kids Heart Family  What is wrong, Tofu?  I don't want to go to school today.  Jim and Jerry took all the tokens I had collected for the charity  and submitted it as their own.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Now they are going to win the appreciation sticker.  Don't worry about it, Tofu.  Sometimes it's okay to let go of things and just hold on to the joy they brought to you.  I don't know, Tia.  Do you know a nice story to help me believe?

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Sure. I'll tell you a story.  A Poor Farmer  Once upon a time, a poor farmer was plowing his field.  When he hit something hard, it was a large metal pot.  What's this? A metal pot?

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: I wonder if there is something more valuable underneath.  In the hope that he could find something more valuable, the farmer dug deeper and wider.  Tired after hours of searching, the farmer decided to rest.  He left his bed in the pot.  And lay down under the tree.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: A while later, when he got up and went back to the pot,  he was surprised.  How is this possible?  The pot is full of hundreds of spades.  I had left only one in it.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Looks like this is a magical pot.  Let me see what will happen if I put a mango in it.  The farmer had thought the one mango turned into hundreds of mangoes when he left it in the pot.  This is truly a magical pot.  I will take it home and use it to tide over our troubles.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The farmer went home and hit the pot at a safe place.  He then went to the market and sold the mangoes.  He earned a handsome sum for them.  On the way back, he brought some grains.  He went home and put each one of them in the pot one by one.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Soon he had enough of grains to last his family for the rest of the year.  The farmer called his wife  and told her everything that had happened.  The farmer went home and took the mangoes.  This is a blessing.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: We should use it wisely to become rich but also keep it safely hidden.  The farmer agreed with his wife.  Over the year, he slowly started putting things in the pot.  Fruits, vegetables, textiles  and in some years, he turned around his family's fortune.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Though they had been secretive and very careful about their magic pot,  people started noticing how they had become rich.  And soon their secret was out.  It even reached the king's ears.  Such a powerful magical pot should be a part of the king's treasury.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The farmer has no right to keep it.  Only I have the right to own that pot.  The king ordered the soldier to bring the pot to the palace.  The soldier stormed into the farmer's home  and confiscated the pot.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: They brought it to the king.  Let me see what is inside the pot that makes it so magical.  Once I find what it is, I will become a hundred times more powerful.  The king peered over the pot and looked into it.  As he did, he lost his balance and fell into the pot.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: As he fell, he hit his head on the edge of the pot and became unconscious.  When he woke up, he saw that there were hundreds of kings like him.  They all fought each other to get to the throne  and died.  Soon the news reached the farmer and his wife.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Should we get the pot back now?  The king was foolish and his curiosity killed him.  But it is not safe to keep the pot anymore.  We have enough money and riches to take care of us and our many next generations.  Let us lead the pot within the king's treasury.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Oh thank you dear.  That was indeed an inspiring story.  And I feel much better now letting go of those tokens.  Good to know that Tufu.  Now will you please finish your cereals so that we can go?
